Mortality rate is a critical clinical outcome metric tracked within the Danish healthcare system, particularly for patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation). Data from the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] and clinical quality indicators such as [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] provide continuous surveillance of survival outcomes across [[danmark|Danmark]]. These metrics are essential for evaluating the long-term prognosis of the condition and the effectiveness of cardiovascular care nationwide.

National mortality figures for prevalent [[atrieflimren]] patients have shown distinct variations across different reporting periods. In one reporting period, 10% of all patients with the condition in [[danmark|Danmark]] died [^src1]. Subsequent reports indicated a national mortality rate of 7.6% for prevalent patients [^src4], which later decreased to 7.3% during the period from July 1, 2023, to June 30, 2024 [^src2], and further to 7.1% for the period spanning July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2025 [^src3]. 

For newly diagnosed patients, the one-year mortality rate serves as a crucial indicator of acute and short-term risks. The proportion of newly diagnosed [[atrieflimren]] patients who died within one year was recorded at 12.5% in recent data [^src2], while another reporting period noted a 1-year post-diagnosis mortality rate of 13.1% [^src4]. 

Geographical disparities in these outcomes are also monitored across the country's five administrative regions: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]. Regional mortality for prevalent patients varied between 7.4% and 7.9% [^src4]. Similarly, the one-year mortality rate following diagnosis exhibited regional variation, ranging from 12.6% to 14.1% [^src4]. Tracking these regional differences helps identify localized areas where clinical interventions or healthcare delivery for [[atrieflimren]] may require optimization.

## Claims

**AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 81-85**
- 10 % af alle patienter med atrieflimren i Danmark døde i opgørelsesperioden [^src1]

**AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 86-90**
- Mortaliteten for prævalente patienter med atrieflimren var 7,3% på landsplan i perioden 1. juli 2023 til 30. juni 2024 [^src1]
- Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der dør inden for 1 år, var 12,5% [^src1]

**AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 71-75**
- Andelen af prævalente patienter med atrieflimren, som døde i opgørelsesperioden 01.07.2024–30.06.2025, var 7,1% på landsplan [^src1]

**AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 106-110**
- Andelen af prævalente patienter med atrieflimren, som døde i opgørelsesperioden var 7,6% på landsplan [^src1]
- Regionalt varierede mortaliteten mellem 7,4 – 7,9% [^src1]
- Andelen der dør 1 år efter diagnose er 13,1% med en regional variation på 12,6-14,1% [^src1]
